subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's in these food-product reviews and what's worth attention or actionable.

judge.implied_focus: Reviewer product experience/satisfaction — the drivers of whether a food product is well-received and repurchase-worthy, plus attention-worthy risk signals

per_column.name: product_category
per_column.rationale: Segmentation dimension enabling satisfaction/complaint analysis by product type.

per_column.name: taste_quality_verdict
per_column.rationale: Core facet of product experience — overall quality judgment.

per_column.name: flavor_profile_match
per_column.rationale: Expectation-vs-reality facet, a driver of satisfaction.

per_column.name: food_safety_concern
per_column.rationale: High-attention risk flag, aligns with 'worth attention'.

per_column.name: repeat_purchase_intent
per_column.rationale: Outcome variable capturing satisfaction consequence — strong actionable target.

per_column.name: use_context
per_column.rationale: Segmentation by usage occasion, contextualizes experience.

per_column.name: health_dietary_signal
per_column.rationale: Attribute capturing health-driven reception and concerns.

judge.rationale: The added columns cohere tightly around a single inferable focus: understanding reviewer product experience/satisfaction and its actionable drivers. They form a well-differentiated structure — segmentation dimensions (product_category, use_context), core experience facets (taste, flavor match, effectiveness), an outcome/target (repeat_purchase_intent), risk/attention flags (food_safety_concern, quality_change, complaint_type), and contextual attributes (brand comparison, health signals). This is neither a single restatement nor generic noise (no bare length/token/sentiment columns); each column is data-inferable from review text at useful granularity. The framing directly answers 'what's worth attention or actionable,' making the implied focus genuinely investigable. Minor deductions: some overlap between taste_quality_verdict, flavor_profile_match, and taste_flavor complaint values introduces mild redundancy rather than fully orthogonal facets.
